Your turn: ten scenarios

Each one is a situation with a person and a folder. Write the line of R they need and press Check. The marking is exact: every bracket, quote and capital letter has to be right, just as R requires. Spacing is the only thing forgiven.

0 of 10 correct
1

Mohamed has just opened R and does not know which folder it is using. What command should he run?

One command, and nothing goes in the brackets.

2

Jaline runs that command and R prints [1] "C:/Users/Jaline/Documents". Her csv is in C:/Users/Jaline/Documents/Data. What command moves R there?

setwd, then the full path in quotes.

3

Shannon has run setwd and nothing at all was printed. She thinks it failed. What should she run to see whether it worked?

Silence means success, so ask R where it is now.

4

Saffa copied this path from Windows Explorer: C:\Users\Saffa\Desktop\Analysis. Write the setwd line that will actually work in R.

Every backslash has to lean the other way.

5

Ousmane is in C:/Users/Ousmane/Downloads and needs to work in C:/Users/Ousmane/Documents/Malaria. Write the command.

It does not matter how far away the folder is: the command is the same.

6

Ricky types setwd(C:/Users/Ricky/Documents) and R says object 'C' not found. Write the line correctly.

A path is text, so it needs quotes around it.

7

Tobias is asked to prove to his supervisor which folder he worked in. What single command gives him the answer to paste into his email?

The same command he started with.

8

Musa is working on a Linux server, where his folder is /home/musa/r-training. Write the command to move there.

No C: on Linux, but the command does not change.

9

Beatrize wants to be sure before she starts and again after she moves. Write all three lines, in order, to move to C:/Users/Beatrize/Downloads/Reports.

Where am I, move me there, did I move correctly.

10

Oumar gets cannot change working directory from his setwd line. Before retyping the path, what command shows him the folder R is in now?

Start from where you are, then correct the path.

Certificate of completion

All correct. Type your name for the certificate.
